page.notes: Running head and page number read from the top of the page. Marginal notes are placed beside the lines where they stand. The note "Iosephi.14." reads as "Iofeph.14." on the scan, so the first letter of the name is doubtful. The text "victum" in the body and "vinctum" in the margin differ as printed. Several marginal abbreviations are cut at the scan edge or set in very small type, so their exact form is uncertain, especially "Niceph.1.", "Niceph.l.1.", "Eusebi l.1." and "vigint.". Some marginal notes sit between lines and their exact line position is approximate.
